= I can only see the message sender's name, not address! =

By default, if the sender, CC or BCC's address is in your address book, Thunderbird will display the person's name but not their email address when you view a message. 

To disable this behavior, select {for win}{menu Tools > Options}{/for}{for linux}{menu Edit > Preferences}{/for}{for mac}{menu Thunderbird > Preferences}{/for}. On the {for not tb38}{menu Advanced} panel > {menu Reading & Display} tab{/for}{for tb38}{menu Display} panel > {menu Advanced} tab{/for}, uncheck "Show only display name for people in my address book".
